own_solution.law: pc = sqrt(K^2 + 2 K mc^2); lambda = hc/pc; sin(theta) = lambda/(2d)
assumptions: electrons reach the crystal with the stated kinetic energy
first-order Bragg reflection, glancing angle from planes

defect_reasons.other: The C cancellation for the film distance is a round trip (compute the ring radius r = q tan 2theta, then recover theta = atan(r/q)/2) rather than a relation the target genuinely needs, and the film is not introduced in the base text; the physics stated is true, so this is a labelling/naturalness point, not an error.

notes: Checked all certified answers: K = 5 keV -> pc = 71.6589 keV, lambda = 17.3042 pm, theta = 2.4794 deg; K = 12.3 -> pc = 112.791 keV, theta = 1.5749 deg; K = 13.4 -> pc = 117.789 keV, theta = 1.5081 deg; K = 14.5 -> pc = 122.594 keV, theta = 1.4490 deg. All match. In pass 1 I classed the film distance D; the authors' C (via the ring geometry r = q tan 2theta, which is correct physics) is acceptable since the film is part of the diffraction apparatus; either way the answer is invariant. Minimal pairs T6CF4/TDC88 and T82C8/T10ED share 8.4 keV and differ only in attachment; TC57E and TE72A are numeral-free twins. Minor tense mismatch in T82C8/TE72A ('gave ... before it reaches') is wording only.
